meta.policy: Public comparison values come only from verified fields below. A fetched official page is not proof of every value on a row. Unknown values are null; historical research stays in its original datasets but is not silently promoted to evidence. Current hours/menu prices are not promises of February/March 2027 availability. No bookings, accounts, deposits or purchases were made.
meta.legacy_data: hotels.json, restaurants.json, activities.json and transit.json retain earlier research. The public views use this field-level manifest, not their row-level verified labels.
meta.external_link_limit: Source pages marked fetched were read with fetch_page on the checked date. Social targets, every hotel link and all archived external links were not exhaustively tested; a CDN refusal is not a confirmed broken URL.
